task_instruction: Rewrite each direct statement in reported speech. Change the tense and time expressions where necessary.
paragraphs: Mia is looking for an apartment and speaks with the landlord, Mr. Lee. He tells her about the building. {{red:"I own this apartment building."}} {{mask_1}} He shows her a one-bedroom apartment. {{red:"The living room gets good sunlight."}} {{mask_2}} Mia asks about the rent. Mr. Lee explains, {{red:"The rent is eight hundred dollars a month."}} {{mask_3}} He adds, {{red:"I am painting the kitchen today."}} {{mask_4}}

Mia asks when she can move in. Mr. Lee checks his calendar and says, {{red:"The apartment is ready now."}} {{mask_5}} He points to a note on the table. {{red:"I will send you the rental agreement tomorrow."}} {{mask_6}} Mia asks about the furniture. Mr. Lee replies, {{red:"You can use this table and these chairs."}} {{mask_7}} He also says, {{red:"The previous tenant left the keys here yesterday."}} {{mask_8}}

Mia calls her brother after the viewing to tell him what the landlord said. She explains, {{red:"Mr. Lee says the building is quiet."}} {{mask_9}} She tells him, {{red:"He is checking the water heater now."}} {{mask_10}} Then she says, {{red:"He will call me this evening."}} {{mask_11}} Her brother asks about the neighborhood. Mia answers, {{red:"There is a grocery store near the apartment."}} {{mask_12}}

The next day, Mr. Lee calls Mia with an update. After the call, Mia tells her brother, {{red:"Mr. Lee said the agreement was ready today."}} {{mask_13}} She adds, {{red:"He said I could read it at his office."}} {{mask_14}} Mia remembers another detail. {{red:"He said the repair worker arrived yesterday."}} {{mask_15}} She also says, {{red:"He said the worker is coming back tomorrow."}} {{mask_16}}

Mia meets Mr. Lee at his office to read the agreement. Afterwards, she tells her brother, {{red:"Mr. Lee said the rent included water."}} {{mask_17}} She continues, {{red:"He said the apartment had a small balcony."}} {{mask_18}} Mia explains that she asked about moving day. {{red:"He said I could collect the keys there on Friday."}} {{mask_19}} Before ending the call, she says, {{red:"He said he would keep a copy for me."}} {{mask_20}}
